title: Clinical Case Workspace
summary: A local-first clinical learning prototype that connects source documents, annotations, reviewed facts and learning questions. Explore its synthetic examples, evidence workflow and knowledge architecture.
problem: How can a highlighted passage become a clinical learning record while preserving its source, review history and uncertainty?
architecture: Source document → annotation → separate human fact review → teaching explanation → confirmed knowledge link → learning archive. The prototype uses synthetic fixtures and fixed Demo services.
designPhilosophy: Keep the source visible. Review facts separately from annotations. Distinguish observations, interpretations and hypotheses; invalidate dependent work when the source changes.
implementation: The local prototype has four main screens, three synthetic cases, four document pages, fourteen hand-defined annotations and seven reviewable facts. Thirteen automated checks passed on 2026-11-17. The public HTML includes a project overview, workflow, synthetic source interaction, knowledge architecture and roadmap; it does not run the application, upload documents or connect to Notion, OCR or a model.
